title: Text messages
lines: Hi there, I’m at a party.
There are lots of girls and boys here.
The food is great.
Lots of balloons.
There is only one problem.
My friends aren’t here!
I’m sad.
I’m at the computer shop with Dad to get my new phone!
Dad is angry.
The sales assistant isn’t here, but the wait isn’t a problem for me.
I’m not bored.
There are lots of cool things here!
I’m at the cinema and I’m so excited!
It’s the first day of the new Star Wars film.
Lots of people are here.
Kim and Olivia are with me.
We’re hungry and thirsty.
We’re at the station.
The train to the airport isn’t here.
It’s late.
The plane is at nine tonight and Mum and Dad are a bit worried.
I’m not worried.
I’m on holiday.
No school for six weeks!!!!!

title: Ruby's birthday
lines: Hi, Ben, how’s it going?
Hey! I’m fine thanks. What about you?
I’m really excited. It’s my birthday.
Your birthday? Today? Isn’t it next week?
No, it’s today. So where’s my present?
Umm, err. Yes, your present. What do you want?
I don’t know. A surprise?
How about tickets for the Camila Cabello concert in June?
Wow – that’s an expensive present. Camila Cabello? No, I don’t like her.
What about a book about football?
Football? Sorry, I don’t like it. I only like tennis.
OK, I know. A 5 Seconds of Summer T-shirt.
No, thanks. I don’t like them any more.
Oh. Can I take you for an ice cream in town? There’s a great new Italian ice cream shop.
Sorry. I don’t like ice cream.
This is difficult. No concert, no book, no T-shirt, no ice cream. How about a big bar of chocolate? No? You don’t like chocolate?
Of course I like chocolate.
You do?
But not milk chocolate. I only like white chocolate.
Only white chocolate. OK.
. I’m only joking. I don’t need a present.
Really?
Yes, and one more thing …
What’s that?
It isn’t my birthday today. It’s next week.

title: Famous families
lines: Emma Watson is a famous English actress.
She is Hermione Granger in the Harry Potter films.
Emma’s mother and father are lawyers.
Her mother’s name is Jacqueline Luesby and her father’s name is Chris Watson.
They live in Oxford, in England.
She’s got two sisters.
They’re twins.
They’re called Lucy and Nina.
She’s also got a brother called Toby and a brother called Alex.
Emma is very busy.
She’s in many films and she is also a UN Goodwill Ambassador.
Chris Hemsworth is a famous Australian actor.
He was born in Melbourne, in 1983, but his grandfather is Dutch and his grandmother is Irish.
His wife’s name is Elsa Pataky.
She is a famous Spanish actress.
They have got three children – two sons and a daughter.
The two boys are twins.
Their names are Sasha and Tristan.
Their daughter’s name is India Rose.

title: Ellie's photo
lines: So, is this your bedroom?
No, it isn’t! It’s my sister Ellie’s bedroom. Do you like it?
I love armchair here. And cushions on the chair are great! But why are we in here?
My cat, Lucky. Look! She’s on the bed. She’s always there.
Oh, yes. She’s very beautiful. Can we take her to your room?
No, let’s leave her here. She’s happy here. Come on. Let’s go to my room and watch a film.
Oh, just a minute, Anna. ’s a nice photograph. Over there, next to the bed.
Yes, it’s me and my family, on holiday in Turkey. We’re all very happy!
Cool. And is your sister Ellie, there?
Yes, it is. That’s Ellie.
Oh, she’s beautiful. And are two people your parents?
Yes, they are.
And who is tall boy next to you? Is it your brother?
No, it isn’t. That’s my cousin. His name’s Max. He lives in Turkey with his mother and father. They’re English teachers.

title: Great cities
lines: Istanbul, Turkey The wonderful city of Istanbul is a great place to visit.
It is an old city, but there are some modern things to see, too.
You can visit the beautiful Topkapi Palace and then go to Sultanahmet Square.
On one side of the square is the Blue Mosque, and, on the other side, the museum of Hagia Sofia.
Take a boat trip on the Bosphorus – the water between the two sides of the city.
Then stop and have coffee – there are many cafés in the city.
Are there any good places to eat?
Of course!
There are many restaurants, and you can eat great fish for lunch or dinner at Kumkapi Market.
Nara, Japan Nara is an old city in Japan, about 400 km from Tokyo.
It isn’t very big – about 400,000 people live there – but it is famous for many things.
Many visitors go to see the Todai-ji Temple, a huge wooden building.
There is a statue inside.
It’s over 15 metres tall!
In the city there is a park with hundreds of deer.
There aren’t any walls in the park, so the deer can walk anywhere in the city.
Buy some special food and give it to them – they love it!

title: Buying in a shop
lines: Morning. Can I help you?
Hello. is a ticket?
Are you over 16?
Yes, I am.
OK, the adult ticket is £15.00. But are you a student?
Yes, I am. Here’s my student card.
OK, that’s fine. So it’s £7.50, then.
Great! Here’s ten pounds.
OK. And, here’s your change – £2.50. Enjoy your visit!
Thanks – bye!
These are nice. I really like them.
Yes, they’re very nice. Very good for all sports.
And they’re comfortable, too. How much?
They’re £150.
Really? Wow. They’re expensive.
Perhaps, but they’re really very, very good trainers. Great for tennis, running … everything!
Yes, you’re right. OK, I’ll them.
OK, great. Let’s go to the desk to pay.
Hello. Do you need a bag?
Um, yes. have one, please?
Sure. They’re 5p each. Wow – that’s a lot of potatoes!
Yes. It’s potato salad for dinner tonight!
Oh, right! So, is that everything?
Yes, thanks.
OK, that’s £6.95 then. How do you want to pay?
By card, please.
Sure. Put it in the machine, please. Thank you. OK, bye – have.
You, too. Bye!

title: Parks around the world
lines: Villa Borghese is a big public park.
There are beautiful gardens, trees and some fountains, too.
People also call it ‘the park of museums’ because there are many interesting museums there.
B Golden Gate Park, San Francisco, US Everyone knows the Golden Gate Bridge, but did you know that there is a Golden Gate Park in San Francisco, too?
It’s very big (4.8km long, almost 1km wide) and at one end you can see the sea.
C Chapultepec Park, Mexico City, Mexico Chapultepec Park is an important green space in this big city.
It has a lake and a hill with a castle on it.
People in Mexico City love going there.
D El Parque del Buen Retiro, Madrid, Spain In Madrid there is a very big park called Buen Retiro.
There are trees and paths and a lovely rose garden, too.
There is also a beautiful glass palace.
E The Iguana Park, Guayaquil, Ecuador The park’s real name is Parque Seminario, but everyone calls it the Iguana Park because it is full of iguanas.
The iguanas are very friendly.
People go there and feed them.
F Mount Faber Park, Singapore On a mountain near Singapore, there is a park called Mount Faber.
You can get there by cable car.
In the park you can walk on a long path, or on an amazing bridge.
You get a great view of the city.
